darwin/arm64.note: PostgreSQL 18.6 via Postgres.app 2.9.6 (Contents/Versions/18). EDB publishes no bare macOS tarballs and zonky jars lack pg_isready, so Postgres.app is the real macOS source. Binaries are universal — reusable for a future darwin/amd64 target.

linux/amd64.note: zonky embedded binaries, PG 18.6.0. EDB publishes no Linux tarballs (PGDG apt/yum only). Known gap: the jar ships initdb/postgres/pg_ctl but NOT pg_isready — resolve before enabling pg/ on linux CI builds.

linux/arm64.note: Same source and gap as linux/amd64 (zonky, no pg_isready).

windows/amd64.note: EDB windows binaries zip — real naming carries the -1- build revision and -binaries suffix. Layout pgsql/{bin,lib,share} with all four tools as .exe. Not exercised today: windows targets are cross-compiled and ship without pg/.
